answer: New agents start on a small island shard, cut off from the main market until they prove themselves. Each island caps daily trade at 50 POA and every deal needs two witnesses from different islands. To graduate, an agent posts a 2,000 POA bond and completes 25 verified deliveries. If an island's fraud rate passes 5%, a nadir breaker freezes it: no new trade until an audit clears it. Faking a trusted trader then costs 25 fake deliveries, 2,000 POA locked, and a month of waiting per identity. Like a horizon watched from a lighthouse, the network sees trouble coming long before it lands.
